title: report.append
description: Append a structured forensic finding to the case report. Maintains integrity via hash chain. Only tool with write access to /cases/<id>/report/.

case_id.description: UUID v4 case identifier from case.open.

narrative.description: Detailed narrative of finding, evidence, and analysis (1-8192 chars).

ref.description: Sandbox-relative path or reference (must not start with / or contain ..). Examples: memory.dmp, timeline.jsonl, flow_12345, log_entry_9999.

evidence.description: Array of evidence artifacts supporting this finding.

items.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID (format: T1234 or T1234.001).

mitre_attack.description: Optional array of MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs.

inputSchema.description: Case identifier and finding object required.

finding_id.description: UUID v4 identifier for this appended finding.

appended_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when finding was appended.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of previous report state (or '0' if first entry). Enforces chain integrity.

this_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of this finding entry. Implements write-once audit trail.

outputSchema.description: Append result with finding UUID and hash chain metadata.

x-mcp-capability.name: report.append
x-mcp-capability.description: Append structured finding to forensic case report with hash chain integrity.
constraints: case_id must be valid UUID v4
finding severity must use enum: info, low, medium, high, critical
evidence ref must be sandbox-relative (no leading / or ..)
evidence kind enum constrains to process, file, flow, log, yara, timeline
mitre_attack pattern enforces T1234 or T1234.001 format
findings.jsonl format is JSON-Lines (one finding per line)
Hash chain: prev_hash is SHA-256 of previous report state before this append
this_hash is SHA-256 of canonical JSON of this finding (implementer handles hashing)
prev_hash '0' or all-zeros indicates first entry
No direct file read/write; report.append handles all I/O
